capabilities: Render interactive Gantt charts from YAML code blocks
Edit charts through a visual editor or a YAML editor that writes back into the note
Track planned versus actual date ranges, progress, status and schedule variance
Sort, filter and display tasks in a customizable table with custom YAML fields as columns
Export charts to PNG, SVG, CSV or print, with themes and custom CSS
extras: The same chart implementation is also shipped as a standalone browser app and a Tauri desktop application. The README advises keeping YAML sources under version control or backed up. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize project schedules as Gantt charts inside Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: OpenGantt is based on the ts-gantt project.

summary: Gantt chart renderer that turns YAML code blocks in notes into interactive project timelines with planned and actual bars, hierarchy, tables and export.
